lines.text: Caesar Augustus decreed a census, so Joseph went from Nazareth in Galilee to Bethlehem in Judea, the city of David.
Mary, who was expecting a child, gave birth to her firstborn Son and laid Him in a basket.
An angel of the Lord told shepherds keeping watch by night that a Savior, Christ the Lord, had been born.
The heavenly host praised God and went into heaven, and the shepherds hurried to Jerusalem and found the Baby.
The shepherds spread the message, all who heard were amazed, Mary treasured these things, and the shepherds returned glorifying God.
